messages:
Maya Iyer: Heads up — I'm seeing a spike in billed tokens for a handful of enterprise customers yesterday that doesn't match the request logs. Can someone help triage?
Liam Chen: which customers? quick grep made?
Maya Iyer: ACME and Brightwave primarily. Invoice ids 2025-11-18-ACME and 2025-11-18-BW. Billing totals show ~35% more tokens than our server-side logs.
Priya Rao: did we run the new SDK release on the proxy fleet on Nov 18? there's a change in embedding batching that could double-report counts if metrics tagging differed.
Liam Chen: yep we pushed sdk-proxy v1.9.2 at 03:12UTC on Nov 18. That build included a metric tag rename from `tokens` -> `token_count` (we intended to map but I missed the backwards-compat shim).
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice 2025-11-18-ACME created (total_tokens=1,235,000, billable_tokens=1,235,000)
Alex Gomez: ok that explains a mismatch possibility. If the billing pipeline reads raw metric keys it could have double-counted when both `tokens` and `token_count` existed in telemetry for a short window.
Priya Rao: good catch. Can we query the timeseries to confirm overlap? I can run an ES query but need the exact metric names.
Liam Chen: looks like for 3m we emitted both names due to a hotfix rollback that didn't fully remove the old emitter. I have the window: 03:11:50 - 03:14:40 UTC.
Maya Iyer: can you paste the ES query you used so finance can reproduce? we'll need to record evidence for crediting customers.
Liam Chen: sure — ran this against metrics-prod: 
```
GET /metrics/_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "filter": [
        {"term": {"metric": "tokens"}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "2025-11-18T03:10:00Z", "lte": "2025-11-18T03:20:00Z"}}}
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
Maya Iyer: Finance will need a delta per invoice (billed - true). Can we compute net credit amounts? Priya, can you estimate token -> $ conversion for these enterprise price tiers?
Priya Rao: ACME is on enterprise tier B: $0.0008 per 1k tokens for generation, embeddings are $0.0012 per 1k — their usage is mostly generation. Rough calc: if they were overbilled by ~280k tokens that's ~280k/1000 * 0.0008 = $0.224 -> rounded to $0.22? that seems tiny, but invoice shows larger because billable_tokens inflated by 280k across many routes. I'll run a route-level breakdown.
Alex Gomez: also check embeddings pipeline — there was a separate metric rename `embed_tokens` -> `embedding_tokens` which might have been conflated.
Liam Chen: confirmed — two rename incidents overlapped for ~2m. I can produce per-route counts.
Maya Iyer: action items: (1) Liam to produce per-customer, per-route true_token_count and billed_token_count CSV. (2) Priya to compute dollar deltas and prepare credit memos. (3) Alex to patch billing parser to ignore duplicate keys and prefer canonical tag. (4) Finance to hold ACME/BW invoices until we confirm adjustments.
Liam Chen: working on export now. I'll drop the CSV in #finance in 15m and ping.
Priya Rao: FYI for approval — anything over $500 needs VP sign-off per policy. If any single customer credit exceeds that we'll need sign-off.
Maya Iyer: likely under but island-check. Also propose a temporary stop-gap: add a pipeline check that flags >5% delta between raw meter and ingest-before-bill and stalls the invoice for manual review. Alex can you add a toggle?
Alex Gomez: yes — can add a feature flag in billing-runner. I'll push a short-lived check and notify ops.
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-11-18 completed with warnings: duplicate_metric_keys detected
Liam Chen: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/for-credit-review/1769178245-token-audit-acme-bw.csv — contains columns {customer, route, billed_tokens, real_tokens, delta_tokens}.
Maya Iyer: thanks. Priya, can you produce the credit memos draft and add the justification lines referencing metric rename bug? We need a short note for customer support.
Priya Rao: drafting now. I'll attach a template credit note and estimated refund amounts.
Maya Iyer: also let's run a backfill script to recalc billable for that day and push corrected invoices if needed. Liam/Alex coordinate; ensure we don't double-run.
Alex Gomez: I'll gate the backfill with idempotency token and a dry-run mode. Plan: dry-run today, apply tomorrow morning if finance approves.
Maya Iyer: sounds good. @Liam please include the dry-run output as well.
Liam Chen: will do.
Priya Rao: FYI — I've done a quick pass: ACME overbilled tokens -> 294,120 tokens -> $235.30 total (mix of generation+embeddings). Brightwave overbilled -> 118,740 tokens -> $95.12. Both under $500.
Maya Iyer: thanks. Finance: proceed with automated credit memos for those two customers and schedule corrected invoices. Approvals not needed for < $500 per policy.
Maya Iyer: I'll update the customer support playbook and send template replies. Closing thread after dry-run confirms numbers. :white_check_mark:
